summary: Signal Stage is a walkable 3D motion-graphics stage with a synchronized, seeded 198-second cinematic on a measured 160-bpm track. A shared director, score/deck clocks and shader helpers drive the stage assemblies and two long vision slots; scene layers use spatially dithered holds across dealt-scene seams.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main, 3D) - black-void stage configuration, spawn/environment and place-wide scripts/look-trip.js post-processing.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - field/eye/serpents composition and scripts/stage.js; field origin and portal at (0,15,-34).
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene and x0z-3.scene - sun-eye, tunnel along -Z, chamber and far tunnel-knot stage pieces.
places/main/cells/x0y2z0.scene through x0y9z0.scene - celestial vision houses above stage; contour oracle, giving-hands, star-jelly and star-child among them.
places/main/cells/x0y10z0.scene through x0y14z0.scene - circuit-oracle, lotus-gate, twin-serpents, weaver, owl-mask and world-turtle vision assemblies.
places/main/cells/objects.scene - three companion-worm meshes attached to the camera for the shared cinematic view.
places/main/cells/ - 23 scene cells and 180 placed objects; stage and outlying cells extend around the main composition.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer services, player/camera templates, movement and cine actions, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player composes humanoid-locomotion.js with scripts/player.js; templates/camera.js#camera runs scripts/camera.js.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - scripts/stage.js synchronizes track/audio and distributes roll/deal parameters.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT actions and cinematic status HUD.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look - installs scripts/look-trip.js as the full-screen post-processing look.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock, section lookup and seeded camera path; used by player, camera, HUD and stage.
scripts/lib/deck.js - cached deterministic per-seed scene-deck deal and track-to-scene-time mapping; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/visions.js - 16-being registry, cached seeded slot deal, vision timing/shots and measured-energy lookup; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and shots.yml - sections, layers, lens, maths, deck and authored camera keys; energy.yml holds measured track data, drops and two 48-second vision slots.

scripts/lib/trip.js - shared shader clocks, kick runs, seeded palette/random choices, scene/layer visibility, lens bending, vision clocks and reusable vision-shader primitives; imported by scripted materials, sky and look.
scripts/field-lib.js - field placement/timing/color helpers plus seamHold/held, a spatially dithered seam-light hold reused by field, eye, serpent, tunnel, sun and chamber materials.

scripts/eye-lib.js, tunnel-lib.js, chamber-lib.js and chamber-fx.js - family-specific spatial, timing and shader helpers; scripts/sun-lib.js and serpents-data.js/serpents-curve.js serve sun-eye and serpent geometry.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js exports update; scripts/look-trip.js exports look; scripts/ui.js exports default.
scripts/lib/cine.js exports CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, rollRnd, cameraAt, beatEnv; scripts/lib/deck.js exports dealDeck, sceneTime.

scripts/lib/visions.js exports BEINGS, dealVisions, visionAt, visionShot, energyAt; scripts/lib/trip.js exports KICK_RUNS, SEC, BPS, tripClock, win, pal, stripes, HUE, shown, lens, bendUv, visionShown and shared vision-shader primitives.
scripts/field-lib.js exports RADIUS, growR, riseR, resetR, endFade, backOut, base, hot, FAMILY, family, colours, breath, seamHold, held.
Vision *-geo modules export geometry/collider (some also spine/ring constants); *-mat modules export material. Worm geo/material pairs provide animated depth-winding bodies.
scripts/tunnel-lib.js exports Z0, FEET, BOUNDS, tun, inside, camDepth, v3, BLUE, base, hot, GRAPH, mirAng; tunnel-core.js, tunnel-gates.js and tunnel-ribs.js export material.
ownership: scripts/player.js - local movement intent/velocity and shared world.state.cine={start,by,seed} or null from cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - shared audio session, roll parameter propagation to trip-tagged materials/look, vision visibility/camera attachment and bench visionTest hold.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - viewer-local camera pose/FOV and seeded authored shot path/move.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js owns avatar gait/sit state; scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js own viewer-local presentation; place/world configs own environment and services.
flows: P/cine action or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine={start: now+300ms,by,seed} or null.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → viewer-local ROLL/CUT and rolling progress/section label.
world.state.cine + score track → #director scripts/stage.js → shared audio at c.start; director stops audio and clears/renews ended cine.
energy.yml → trip.js KICK_RUNS and visions.js slot timing → stage.js seeded choice from built BEINGS; vision materials receive vw0/vw1 or -1/-1.
stage.js → trip-tagged material/look params t0/on/seed, kick bounds k0/k1 and dealt scene mappings ds0..ds3/dr0..dr3; look also receives current vision slot v0/v1.
stage.js + vision-<id> tags → selected being layers and worms attach to camera starting 3 s before their slot at depth 74 with layer offsets; others return home unless held by visionTest.
score.yml + deck.js → one seeded scene across [12.35,180.35] per roll → cine.js cameraAt and trip.js shader scene clock share assigned source section/rate.
cine.js cameraAt → scripts/camera.js viewer camera; dealt beings and companion worms join the camera view rather than replacing it with separate vision shots.
stage.js computes camera-shot-dependent fit scale for camera-attached vision layers so the whole being stays in front of the viewed subject; applies same factor to depth and scale.
score.yml + trip.js tripClock/shown/lens/mask helpers → field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber, vision assemblies and look-trip shader timing/cutouts.
trip.js supplies scene sec and seamD → field-lib.js seamHold/held → selected far scene layers remain lit as spatially hashed beads near a dealt seam, combined with their normal shown opacity.
look-trip.js reads scene depth and vision v0/v1 → subject-aware near-only depth of field and seeded kick jobs; peak mirror imagery appears opaquely through one dealt symbol window.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - mandala, stalks, orbs and glyph/cartouche field layers share field-lib.js placement/timing; mandala, disc and stalk motifs vary, with seam holds on the mandala.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids, beads and knot make the portal; eye-lib.js shares eye math and iris geometry is reused for pupil with different parameters; iris uses a seam hold.

scripts/serpents-* - co-located layers build striped/scaled bodies, arches, beads, cones, knots, rose beads and totem; serpents-lib.js/serpents-curve.js share appearance and spine/frame calculations; cones join the seam hold.
scripts/tunnel-* - wall, core, dust, gates, ribs and knot share tunnel geometry kinds and tunnel-lib.js spatial/color helpers; materials vary motif and seeded palette; wall holds at scene seams.
scripts/chamber-* - room, circuit, hands, hex, Lissajous, solids and bilateral mask share chamber shader helpers and scored cutouts; room uses a seam hold.
scripts/sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js and sun-halo.js - sun-eye layers share sun-lib.js but vary disc, hanging-drip and depth-halo imagery; disc uses a seam hold.

scripts/vision-*-geo.js / -mat.js - 16 staged beings share trip clocks and layer offsets; motifs and seeded entrance/exit masks vary by being. vision-sun-father-mat.js confines exit glow to growing ray tips and bead rims, not whole rays.

scripts/companion-worm-geo.js, vision-*-worm-geo.js and corresponding worm materials - camera-attached and vision-being worms share unit-tube geometry bent by shader paths; geo resolution scales by ctx.lod.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead. cine.js uses milliseconds for start/ctx.now() and seconds for score/shot keys.

stage.js converts c.start to shader t0 seconds modulo 3600 and repeats parameter pushes over several ticks so late-built materials receive the roll; trip-tagged materials need t0/on/seed and kick bounds k0/k1.

energy.yml defines vision slots [48.35,96.35] and [132.35,180.35]; only built entries in BEINGS can be dealt. Vision layers attach 3 s before a slot; vision houses are above the field in +Y and selected layers ride the camera at depth 74.
score.yml deck has one segment [12.35,180.35] per roll; preserve distinction between deck source time and full trip clock, plus fixed 12 s seed/return sections.
Canonical vision layer offsets are world -30, ring -12, being 0, veil +10, fore +22; stage.js derives home z from tag suffix and fit scales depth and object scale together.

field-lib seamHold uses trip scene time c.sec, score layer intervals and c.seamD (seconds to nearest dealt-deck boundary); held=max(normal opacity, hold). Its hashed 3D bead cells are measured in world units, so keep each caller's explicit scale.
